title: Debug Interface
concept: The Debug interface provides developer-facing output showing internal state — used for logging, debugging, and development diagnostics.
why: When your program misbehaves, you need to see inside your types. Debug gives you a no-compromises view of the data, not a pretty presentation.
tips: Derive Debug for every public type — it costs nothing and helps debugging enormously
Debug is for developers — show raw values, not formatted output
Use :? in format strings for Debug output — `format("val: {:?}", x)`
Manually implement Debug to hide sensitive fields (passwords, tokens, keys)
common_mistakes: Not deriving Debug — makes println debugging impossible for that type
Leaking secrets in Debug output — override Debug for types containing sensitive data
Using Debug for user-facing output — always use Display for end users
